review: Inspected both complete section screenshots. The three experiment/planner rows form labelled cards on mobile and a readable table on desktop. Distinctions between full rounds, short output events, synthetic graphs and floating-point planning stay visible. Body text and both full-button evidence links wrap without clipping.
scope: Selected section visual inspection only; source bytes, keyboard entry and six viewport/JavaScript modes are tested separately. No whole-library or attack-proof certification.
